GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 21, 2024
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PRM ADMINISTRATION, LARGE CONFERENCE ROOM, 2:30 PM

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52454-01 Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Golf Advisory Committee meeting
  of Thursday, November 2, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-52455-01 Recommendation to receive and file the City Golf Operations oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-52456-01 Recommendation to receive and file the American Golf oral updates on the
  courses, capital improvement projects, and other items.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-52457-01 Recommendation to receive and file the Subcommittee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-52458-01 Recommendation to receive and file the course netting process update.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-52459-01 Recommendation to approve the American Golf fees request for 2024-2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
